description.value:
Clear streams of water have been magically solidified into a glimmering, iridescent pinwheel that looks as fragile as glass. When affixed, it spins gently without a breeze.

  • Armor You gain resistance 3 to persistent acid damage and persistent fire damage.

  • Weapon After you cast a water spell by Activating the enduring helix, your Strikes with the weapon deal @Damage[1d4[persistent,cold]] damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Hydrating Pinwheel - Weapon]

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Rousing Splash].
